hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.swift) command -v swiftformat >/dev/null && swiftformat "$f";; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.swift) if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.swiftlint.yml" ]; then command -v swiftlint >/dev/null && swiftlint lint --strict --quiet "$f"; fi;; esac; }
